name: Personal Current Account Opening — Event Catalogue
description: Authoritative catalogue of all domain events published during JRN-001. Events are the mechanism for cross-service state propagation (SVC-102 event bus). Each event entry specifies: owning service, source entity, trigger condition, journey phase, payload schema, consuming services with action descriptions, ordering guarantees, topic, data classification, WORM audit pipeline flag, capability scope, and CloudEvents type. Consumers listed under each event are subscriptions in effect at the time of publication — synchronous API call results are not events and are not listed here.
catalogue_principles: Every event name is in past tense (domain event naming convention): the event records a fact that has occurred.
Payload schemas carry the minimum data required for consumers to act. Raw PII fields (document images, biometric scores, full PAN) are never included in event payloads.
All events tagged data_classification: pii or data_classification: financial are routed to the WORM audit pipeline (SVC-111) in addition to their primary consumers.
Intra-capability events are consumed only by services within the same capability domain. Cross-capability events cross at least one capability boundary.
Ordering guarantees apply at the event bus (SVC-102) level. The partition key determines per-key ordering — all events for a given customer_id are strictly ordered within a topic partition.

events.name: ApplicationStarted
events.trigger: PER-001 submits the account application form via web portal (CH-001) or mobile app (CH-002). SVC-017 calls SVC-001 to create a Customer (prospect) and ApplicationRecord with status = in_progress. ApplicationRecord.application_id is assigned and ApplicationStarted is published.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (Retail Banking / SVC-001); consumed by CAP-005 (Compliance & Regulatory / SVC-050) and CAP-007 (Digital Channels / SVC-017). Crosses CAP-001 → CAP-005 and CAP-001 → CAP-007 boundaries.

payload_schema.application_id: string (UUID v4) — provisional application reference; immutable after publication
payload_schema.customer_id: string (UUID v4) — prospect customer record identifier

consumers.action: Initialises the application flow UI; displays the provisional application reference to PER-001
Initialises the identity verification workflow for the customer; prepares document capture session with the identity verification vendor (Onfido/Jumio)
Creates immutable audit log entry recording the application initiation event with application_id, customer_id, channel, and timestamp

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.applications. All JRN-001 events for a given customer_id are sequenced within the same partition.
events.worm_rationale: Contains customer_id (PII). Consumer Duty evidence: application initiation is part of the regulated application audit trail. Retained in SVC-111 for 7 years (FCA BCOBS / GOV-001-R01).

events.name: IdentityVerificationCompleted
events.trigger: SVC-050 receives the terminal verification result from the identity verification vendor (Onfido/Jumio). Document authenticity check, biometric liveness check, and address verification are all assessed. SVC-050 persists the outcome in the IdentityVerification entity and publishes this event with the outcome (pass | refer | fail | fraud_detected).
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (Compliance & Regulatory / SVC-050); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001), CAP-007 (SVC-017), and additional compliance services (SVC-014, SVC-103, SVC-111). Crosses CAP-005 → CAP-001 and CAP-005 → CAP-007 boundaries.
events.payload_omissions: Payload must not include raw document images, document_number, biometric_match_score, or address detail. Raw data is retained within SVC-050 encrypted storage under MLR 2017 Regulation 40 five-year retention. Outcome only.

consumers.action: Consumes verified identity data (name, DOB, address, nationality — retrieved from SVC-050 internal entity, not from this payload) to initiate PEP, sanctions, and adverse media screening in PH-003
Records identity verification outcome against the ApplicationRecord; outcome = fraud_detected causes ApplicationRecord to transition to suspended status

Advances the application wizard from the PH-002 capture screen: outcome = pass advances to PH-003 holding screen; outcome = fail displays retry/branch referral message; outcome = fraud_detected triggers EX-003 exception path
Creates immutable audit log entry; CDD evidence record required for FCA/NCA records production within 2 business days
Archives event to WORM store; MLR 2017 Regulation 40 five-year CDD retention obligation

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.identity. Only one active IdentityVerification per application_id — sequencing relative to ApplicationStarted is guaranteed by the same partition key.
events.worm_rationale: CDD record under MLR 2017 Regulation 40 (five-year retention). Contains customer_id and identity verification outcome. Biometric and document data remain in SVC-050 encrypted storage; this event carries outcome metadata only.
events.retention: 5 years minimum (MLR 2017 Regulation 40); 7 years where outcome = fraud_detected (FCA fraud record obligation)

events.name: SanctionsScreeningCompleted
events.trigger: SVC-014 calls SVC-051 (Sanctions Screening Service) synchronously during PH-003. SVC-051 returns a sanctions screening result (clear | hit | pending_review) from the OFSI Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UN Consolidated List, and EU sanctions lists. SVC-014 persists the result in KycAssessment.sanctions_screening_result and publishes this event. If the result is hit, SanctionsHitDetected (EVT-006) is published immediately after.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by SVC-014 (CAP-005); consumed primarily within CAP-005 (SVC-051 audit, SVC-103). SVC-001 consumes it cross-capability to gate account provisioning. However, the primary compliance workflow is contained within CAP-005 services.

payload_schema.match_confidence: number (0.0–1.0) — present only when screening_result = hit or pending_review; omitted when clear

events.payload_omissions: List-specific match detail and matched entity names must not appear in the event payload. Full match detail is retained in SVC-014/SVC-103 audit records. Tipping-off prohibition (POCA 2002 s333A): payload must not be surfaced to PER-001.

consumers.action: Internal consumption: updates KycAssessment.sanctions_screening_result; determines whether to proceed with full CDD risk scoring or to escalate via SanctionsHitDetected
Creates immutable audit log entry; OFSI requires a complete audit log of all sanctions screening decisions, including CLEAR results
Archives event to WORM store; five-year OFSI audit retention obligation (GOV-005-R02)

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.kyc. Strictly follows IdentityVerificationCompleted (EVT-002) in the partition — MLR 2017 sequencing enforced by SVC-014 subscription dependency.
events.worm_rationale: OFSI requires audit log of all sanctions screening decisions for five years (GOV-005-R02). Contains customer_id and screening result — classified restricted rather than pii as the sensitive data is the match result, not personal identity fields.

events.name: KYCClearanceGranted
events.trigger: KycAssessment is completed with: pep_screening_result.status = clear, sanctions_screening_result.status = clear, adverse_media_result.severity = low or none, and risk_category = standard or simplified. For the AP-001 alternative path (PEP/EDD referral), this event is published only after MLRO (PER-052) sign-off is recorded in KycAssessment with assessor = manual_mlro_approved.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (Compliance & Regulatory / SVC-014); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) as the gating signal that unlocks account provisioning. This is the primary cross-capability compliance gate event for JRN-001.

payload_schema.next_review_date: string (ISO 8601 UTC date) — perpetual KYC review date based on risk_category

consumers.action: Receives the gating signal that allows account provisioning to proceed. Transitions ApplicationRecord.current_phase to PH-005. No Account record may be created by SVC-001 without first receiving this event (MLR 2017 Regulation 27 technical enforcement).
Marks the KYC/CDD step of the onboarding workflow as complete; closes the identity verification orchestration session
Advances the application wizard UI from the PH-003 KYC holding screen to the PH-004 account decision result screen
Creates immutable audit log entry; CDD clearance record required for FCA supervision evidence
Archives event; MLR 2017 Regulation 40 CDD clearance record retention

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.kyc. Published after SanctionsScreeningCompleted (EVT-003) in the same partition. Mutually exclusive with KYCReferralRaised (EVT-005) and SanctionsHitDetected (EVT-006) for a given assessment_id.
events.worm_rationale: CDD clearance record under MLR 2017 Regulation 40. The event is the gating signal for account opening — it must be retained as evidence that CDD was completed before the business relationship was established.
events.retention: 5 years minimum (MLR 2017 Regulation 40); 7 years where account subsequently opened (FCA BCOBS)

events.name: KYCReferralRaised
events.trigger: KycAssessment returns any of: risk_category = enhanced (high-risk score), pep_screening_result.status = match (PEP identified), or adverse_media_result.severity = high. The automated CDD assessment cannot grant clearance. A referral is raised for manual Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) review via the AP-001 alternative path. MLRO (PER-052) is notified immediately.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (SVC-014); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) to suspend account provisioning, and by CAP-007 (SVC-017) to display the referral status message to PER-001. Triggers the AP-001 manual EDD alternative path.

payload_schema.referral_reason: string enum (pep_identified | high_risk_score | adverse_media | edd_required | combined)

events.payload_omissions: Specific PEP database match detail, adverse media article references, or risk scoring factors must not appear in the payload. These are retained in SVC-014 CDD records under MLRO access control. Tipping-off prohibition (POCA 2002 s333A): if SAR consideration is live, referral_reason must not disclose this to consuming services outside the MLRO governance boundary.

consumers.action: Transitions ApplicationRecord.status to referred and current_phase to AP-001; suspends account provisioning pending EDD completion
Displays the additional review required message to PER-001 with the three-business-day SLA and case reference; triggers SVC-053 to dispatch the referral notification email
Dispatches EDD referral email to PER-001 (customer-facing, without disclosing PEP or SAR detail) and internal alert to compliance case management queue for PER-052 (MLRO) review
Creates immutable audit log entry; CDD referral record required for MLR 2017 Regulation 33 EDD evidence trail

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.kyc. Mutually exclusive with KYCClearanceGranted (EVT-004) and SanctionsHitDetected (EVT-006) for a given assessment_id — only one terminal KYC outcome event per assessment.
events.worm_rationale: CDD EDD referral record under MLR 2017 Regulations 33–35. Contains customer_id and referral reason — evidence that enhanced due diligence was correctly triggered.

events.name: SanctionsHitDetected
events.trigger: KycAssessment receives a blocked result from SVC-051 (sanctions_screening_result.status = blocked), indicating the customer matches a designated person on the OFSI Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UN Consolidated List, or EU sanctions lists. Account opening is immediately and irrevocably blocked. MLRO escalation (EX-002 exception path) is triggered. OFSI notification obligation begins (14-day clock).
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (SVC-014); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) to block account creation, CAP-007 (SVC-017) for customer-facing generic decline, and compliance workflow services. A critical cross-capability control event.

payload_schema.list_name: string — name of the sanctions list on which the match was found (e.g. OFSI, OFAC_SDN, UN, EU)

events.payload_omissions: Matched entity name, designation reference, or full match detail must not appear in the event payload. This data is retained in SVC-014/SVC-103 MLRO-governed records only. Under no circumstances may this payload be surfaced to PER-001 (tipping-off prohibition, POCA 2002 s333A).

consumers.action: Immediately blocks account provisioning; transitions ApplicationRecord.status to blocked; if any funds were received, triggers account freeze obligation
Displays a generic decline message to PER-001 without disclosing the sanctions match reason (tipping-off prohibition); triggers standard decline email via SVC-053
Dispatches internal MLRO escalation alert to PER-052 (MLRO) via secure internal channel; dispatches generic decline communication to PER-001
Creates immutable audit log entry; OFSI audit trail initiation — this log record is the start of the 14-day OFSI notification clock evidence
Archives event immediately to WORM store; OFSI may request production of this record during regulatory inspection

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.kyc. Mutually exclusive with KYCClearanceGranted (EVT-004) and KYCReferralRaised (EVT-005) for a given assessment_id. Published as soon as the blocked screening result is received — no delay.
events.data_classification_note: Elevated beyond standard restricted classification. Access to this event and its consumers' persisted records is restricted to MLRO-governance boundary services (SVC-014, SVC-103, SVC-111) and authorised personnel (PER-052). Must not appear in general operations dashboards.
events.worm_rationale: OFSI compliance obligation: all sanctions hit records must be retained and producible on demand. The 14-day OFSI notification clock makes prompt and immutable archival essential.
events.retention: 10 years (OFSI enforcement evidence; exceeds standard MLR 2017 five-year minimum)

events.name: ApplicationDecisionMade
events.trigger: The automated account decision engine in SVC-001 evaluates the combined outputs of identity verification (IdentityVerificationCompleted), KYC/CDD (KYCClearanceGranted or KYCReferralRaised), and eligibility checks. An Approve, Refer, or Decline decision is produced and persisted in ApplicationRecord.decision_outcome. The event is published regardless of outcome, with the decision_basis_ref linking to the evidence record. For referred applications, this event is published when the manual review (AP-001) concludes.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-001); consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-050, SVC-111), CAP-007 (SVC-017), and compliance services. The decision event crosses capability boundaries to trigger customer notification, compliance record-keeping, and downstream provisioning.

payload_schema.decision_basis_ref: string (UUID v4) — internal reference to the decision audit record in SVC-001; not a direct link to CDD data
payload_schema.decline_reason: string enum (kyc_failure | sanctions_hit | identity_fraud | policy_exclusion | eligibility_failure) — present only when decision_outcome = declined; omitted if approved or referred
payload_schema.referral_reason: string enum (high_risk_score | pep_edd_pending | manual_review_required) — present only when decision_outcome = referred; omitted otherwise

events.payload_omissions: Full decision scoring model outputs, specific CDD data inputs, or SAR consideration status must not appear in the payload. The decision_basis_ref is an opaque reference — consuming services must not reconstruct CDD data from it.

consumers.action: Renders the decision result screen: approval confirmation message, referral status with three-business-day SLA, or decline notification with FOS signpost (Consumer Duty requirement)
Closes or archives the onboarding case; for declined applications, archives the identity verification record per MLR 2017 Regulation 40 retention obligations
Creates immutable audit log entry; the decision audit trail must be retained for minimum five years for FCA supervision evidence (Consumer Duty, AI/ML model validation)
Archives event; Consumer Duty evidence that the decision was communicated; AI/ML model decision audit

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.applications. Published after KYCClearanceGranted (EVT-004) or KYCReferralRaised (EVT-005) in the partition — the KYC gating dependency ensures this ordering.
events.worm_rationale: Contains customer_id and decision outcome — PII. Consumer Duty evidence of fair treatment; AI/ML decision audit trail. FCA requires decision records for minimum five years (raised to seven years under FCA BCOBS for account decisions).

events.name: AccountOpened
events.trigger: SVC-001 creates the Account record in PH-005 following receipt of KYCClearanceGranted (EVT-004) and ApplicationDecisionMade with outcome = approved. The Account is created with status = pending (sort code and account number assigned but not yet fully active). This is the primary domain event of JRN-001 — it establishes the Customer aggregate root as active and creates the FSCS Single Customer View record.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-001); consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-050, SVC-111) for compliance record finalisation and CAP-007 (SVC-017) for the customer-facing account confirmation screen. The foundational domain event for all downstream retail journeys.

payload_schema.sort_code: string (6-digit UK sort code, format: NN-NN-NN)
payload_schema.iban: string (GB IBAN, format: GBkk BBBB SSSS SSCC CCCC CC)
payload_schema.fscs_eligible: boolean — FSCS depositor protection eligibility flag
payload_schema.account_status: string enum (pending | active) — pending at AccountOpened; active at AccountProvisioned

consumers.action: Advances the application wizard UI to the account details confirmation screen in PH-005; displays sort code and account number to PER-001
Marks the onboarding journey as complete; closes the onboarding case with the account_id as the confirmed outcome reference
Triggers the account opening confirmation push notification to the mobile app
Creates immutable audit log entry; account opening record required for FCA BCOBS seven-year retention
Archives event; FSCS evidence record; PRA Depositor Protection compliance — FSCS SCV must be updatable within 24 hours of a payout trigger

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.accounts. Published after ApplicationDecisionMade (EVT-007) with outcome = approved in the partition. AccountOpened must precede AccountProvisioned (EVT-009) for the same account_id.
events.worm_rationale: Primary financial domain event. Contains account_id, customer_id, sort code, account number, and FSCS flag — financial and PII data. FSCS compliance requires immutable evidence of account opening. FCA BCOBS seven-year retention.

events.name: AccountProvisioned
events.trigger: Account record transitions from status = pending to status = active in SVC-001 after: (1) FSCS SCV record is created or updated, (2) CASS registration is initiated with Pay.UK, (3) opening balance is confirmed at zero, and (4) account attributes are fully configured. This event signals that the account is operationally live and ready for customer access.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-001); consumed by CAP-007 (SVC-017) to advance to digital channel activation (PH-006), and compliance services for FSCS/CASS evidence. This event gates the transition from provisioning to digital activation.

payload_schema.cass_registered: boolean — true when CASS registration with Pay.UK has been initiated

consumers.action: Confirms sort code and account number are live; advances the application wizard to the PH-006 digital channel activation setup screen
Dispatches account active confirmation notification; triggers card delivery tracking notification based on CardIssuanceTriggered (EVT-010)
Creates immutable audit log entry; account provisioning record including CASS registration flag
Archives event; CASS participation evidence; FSCS SCV confirmation record

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.accounts. Strictly follows AccountOpened (EVT-008) for the same account_id. CardIssuanceTriggered (EVT-010) is published in the same phase but may follow in any order after AccountProvisioned.
events.worm_rationale: Financial event: confirms the account is operationally active with sort code and account number. CASS registration evidence. FCA BCOBS and PRA Depositor Protection retention.

events.name: CardIssuanceTriggered
events.trigger: SVC-001 creates the CardIssuance record in PH-005, linking it to the newly provisioned Account. The card processing service (SVC-011 / Marqeta or Thredd) is instructed to initiate physical card production. The event is published to notify downstream services and the customer of the card dispatch workflow. Card production and delivery typically takes three to five working days.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-001); consumed by CAP-007 (SVC-017) for the customer-facing card delivery notification. The card processor (SVC-011) receives this as a direct API trigger, not as an event subscription.

payload_schema.estimated_delivery_date: string (ISO 8601 UTC date) — based on card processor SLA
payload_schema.delivery_address_postcode: string (UK postcode only — not full address, for notification purposes)

events.payload_omissions: PAN (Primary Account Number), CVV2, expiry date, and full delivery address must not appear in the event payload. PCI DSS v4.0 compliance: card number is generated and stored exclusively within the card processor (SVC-011 / Marqeta / Thredd) PCI DSS-compliant environment. Only the card_id opaque reference is published.

consumers.action: Displays the estimated card delivery date on the account summary screen in PH-005 and on the welcome dashboard in PH-007; triggers card dispatch notification via SVC-053
Dispatches card dispatch confirmation notification to PER-001 (push and email) with the estimated delivery date
Creates immutable audit log entry; card issuance record for PCI DSS audit trail

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.cards. Published in PH-005 after AccountProvisioned (EVT-009) in the standard flow. The card processor (SVC-011) is triggered via a synchronous API call from SVC-001, not via this event.
events.data_classification_note: Delivery address postcode and customer_id included. No cardholder data (PAN/CVV2) in payload — PCI DSS scope is limited to the card processor environment.
events.worm_rationale: PCI DSS v4.0 requires an audit trail for card issuance events. Contains customer_id and card_id — PII. Visa/Mastercard scheme rules also require issuance records.
events.retention: 7 years (PCI DSS v4.0 audit requirement; FCA BCOBS)

events.name: DigitalChannelActivated
events.trigger: DigitalEnrollment.status transitions to active in SVC-017 after the customer completes the following in PH-006: (1) online banking credentials created and stored in SVC-100 (IAM), (2) FIDO2/WebAuthn biometric SCA factor enrolled and device registered with SVC-100, (3) push notification permissions configured, (4) first-login SCA authentication completed successfully (password + biometric). This event signals that the customer has operational digital access to their account.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-007 (Digital Channels / SVC-017); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) to confirm the account is accessible, and by compliance services. This event marks the functional completion of the account opening journey.
events.payload_omissions: Biometric template data must not appear in the payload. Under FIDO2/WebAuthn, the biometric template never leaves the device — only the cryptographic assertion is transmitted to SVC-100. UK GDPR Article 9 special category data minimisation.

consumers.action: Confirms the account is operationally accessible to the customer; updates any account-level digital access flag
Triggers the welcome pack dispatch workflow in PH-007 (this event is the entry condition for PH-007)
Creates immutable audit log entry; SCA enrolment record required for PSR 2017 Regulation 100 compliance evidence

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.channels. Published after AccountProvisioned (EVT-009) — the AccountProvisioned event is the entry condition for PH-006. Strictly precedes WelcomePackDispatched (EVT-013).
events.worm_rationale: SCA enrolment record: PSR 2017 Regulation 100 and FCA RTS on SCA compliance evidence. Contains customer_id and channel activation status — PII.

events.name: CustomerRiskScoreUpdated
events.trigger: A perpetual KYC (pKYC) periodic review of an existing customer's KycAssessment results in a changed risk_category or changed risk_score. This may be triggered by: (1) scheduled periodic review based on next_review_date in the KycAssessment, (2) SanctionsListUpdated event from SVC-051 triggering batch portfolio rescreening, (3) adverse media monitoring detecting a new negative news item, or (4) MLRO-initiated manual review. This event is not phase-specific — it occurs throughout the life of the customer relationship post-onboarding.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (Compliance & Regulatory / SVC-014); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) to adjust account-level monitoring thresholds. Although not phase-specific to JRN-001, it is published by SVC-014 throughout the customer relationship lifecycle established by JRN-001.

payload_schema.assessment_id: string (UUID v4) — updated KycAssessment entity identifier

consumers.action: Adjusts account-level transaction monitoring thresholds to reflect the updated CDD risk tier; for risk_category escalations (e.g. standard → enhanced), may trigger account controls review or temporary transaction limits
Creates immutable audit log entry; pKYC risk score change record required for MLR 2017 ongoing monitoring evidence

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.kyc. No strict ordering dependency with other event types — this event may occur at any time post-onboarding. Multiple CustomerRiskScoreUpdated events for the same customer are ordered by updated_at within the partition.
events.worm_rationale: Ongoing CDD monitoring record under MLR 2017 Regulation 28 (ongoing monitoring obligation). Risk score changes are compliance-sensitive records.
events.retention: 5 years from the date of update (MLR 2017 Regulation 40)

events.name: WelcomePackDispatched
events.trigger: SVC-017 confirms successful delivery of the welcome communications in PH-007: (1) welcome email (including FSCS information sheet and account details) dispatched via SVC-053, (2) in-app welcome message displayed and acknowledged, (3) FSCS information sheet delivery confirmed. The event is published only when delivery is confirmed — not on dispatch attempt. GOV-001-R02 mandates FSCS information sheet delivery at account opening.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-007 (Digital Channels / SVC-017); consumed by SVC-103 and SVC-111 within the compliance and audit layer. Primary consumers are within the audit/compliance boundary rather than crossing into a product capability. This event marks the terminal state of JRN-001.

payload_schema.channels_used: array<string enum (email | in_app | push)> — delivery channels through which the welcome pack was successfully dispatched
payload_schema.fscs_sheet_delivered: boolean — explicit flag confirming FSCS information sheet delivery (GOV-001-R02 compliance evidence)
payload_schema.vulnerability_screening_completed: boolean — flag confirming PH-007 wellbeing questions were surfaced to PER-001 (FCA FG21/1)

consumers.action: Creates immutable audit log entry; Consumer Duty evidence that all required disclosures (FSCS information sheet, product terms) were communicated at account opening
Archives event for five years; GOV-001-R02 mandatory FSCS information sheet delivery evidence; Consumer Duty disclosure audit record

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.channels. Published after DigitalChannelActivated (EVT-011) for the same customer_id. This is the terminal event of the JRN-001 happy path.
events.worm_rationale: Mandatory Consumer Duty disclosure evidence (GOV-001-R02). The FSCS information sheet delivery confirmation is a regulatory obligation — this event is the proof of delivery. Retained in SVC-111 WORM store for five years.
events.retention: 5 years (Consumer Duty evidence; GOV-001-R02 FSCS disclosure obligation)

topic_summary.description: All events in this catalogue are published via SVC-102 (Event Bus). Topics are logical partitioning boundaries; all topics use customer_id as the default partition key unless otherwise noted.

intra_capability_events: EVT-003 SanctionsScreeningCompleted (within CAP-005; cross-capability audit consumers only)
EVT-013 WelcomePackDispatched (within CAP-007; cross-capability audit consumers only)

worm_audit_pipeline_summary.description: All 13 events in this catalogue are routed to the WORM audit pipeline (SVC-111). All events in JRN-001 carry either PII (customer_id, account data), financial data (sort code, account number, decision outcome), or compliance-classified data (CDD outcomes, sanctions results). No event in this catalogue is exempt from WORM archival.

retention_tiers.regulatory_basis: FCA BCOBS; Consumer Duty; PRA Depositor Protection
